# Vendored mit48px OCR implementation

`mit48px_ctc.py` is copied from BallonsTranslator's mit48px CTC OCR module,
which notes that it was modified from manga-image-translator's
`ocr/model_48px_ctc.py` implementation.

The repository's GPL-3.0 license applies. The alphabet is stored in
`data/alphabet-all-v5.txt`. The model checkpoint is expected at
`data/models/mit48pxctc_ocr.ckpt` and is intentionally ignored by Git because
of its size.
